stopping_rule.text: Execute candidates strictly in campaign_order. If a candidate fails its own predeclared advancement criteria, do NOT tune it -- proceed to the next predeclared candidate. If a candidate honestly satisfies every required advancement gate, STOP the remaining candidate campaign and proceed to promotion verification for that candidate only. Do not substitute a fourth candidate. Do not invent a new candidate after seeing any result.

candidate_selection_constraints: materially different from every previously tested return-trend/short-horizon-return/gap/volatility mechanism in tested_hypothesis_exclusion_matrix
not a threshold, K, rank-band, turnover, rebalance-interval, cost-assumption, lookback, or universe tweak of any previously tested mechanism
executable using current causal next-bar economic_walk_forward_v1 machinery
economically interpretable and supported by a primary peer-reviewed reference
no reliance on inaccessible proprietary data (no fundamentals, no earnings calendar, no shares-outstanding)
no requirement for new multi-asset infrastructure
no requirement to weaken production/backtest conservatism
universe_reuse_rationale: Both candidates reuse the SAME already-committed, already-exercised-twice (SHORT-WAVE-03, DISCOVERY-01) 88-symbol current-registry-snapshot universe (universe_id=f25e8ec952c1429af7ac3bb58169408e), not a fresh point-in-time universe. LIQ-01's mechanism (illiquidity risk premium) specifically requires genuine cross-sectional variation in liquidity, which a fixed liquid-ETF-only universe would suppress by construction -- the broader mixed equity+ETF snapshot is the scientifically appropriate choice for that mechanism, and reusing the identical universe for VOL-01 keeps the only varying factor between this campaign's two candidates the feature itself. This is not a fresh PIT universe manufactured to enlarge the campaign.

holdout_reservation.policy: Each candidate reserves its own final holdout window (2024-11-01..2025-05-01, WF_HOLDOUT_MONTHS=6) via mqk_research.ml.holdout_ledger.reserve_holdout. holdout_id is content-bound to that candidate's own feature/bars dataset identity (compute_holdout_id), so LIQ-01, VOL-01, and DISCOVERY-01's own reserved holdout are three structurally distinct ledger entries even though the calendar window is identical for all three. No candidate in this campaign may call consume_holdout.

prohibited_after_this_commit: adding a third or fourth candidate to campaign_order without a new, separately-reviewed predeclaration
reordering campaign_order after seeing any candidate's result
retuning LIQ-01 or VOL-01 (window/threshold/universe/horizon) after seeing its own result
relabeling a previously tested mechanism (see tested_hypothesis_exclusion_matrix) as a new candidate
claiming PROVEN_ALPHA or PROMOTION_READY for either candidate
consuming the reserved final holdout for either candidate
starting Paper, arming Paper, starting the daemon, or submitting any broker order from this campaign's Lane-A work
